purpose: Repeatable hardware observations for feature comparisons; host simulation is not device timing.
comparison_requirements: Record firmware version and explicit source revision label.
Use the same patch IDs, exact edits, notes, velocities, releases, effects and musical timing.
Reset the diagnostic session on the device before each run; do not reset during capture.
Keep workload duration, scene, diagnostic visibility and host polling frequency the same.
Record raw JSON; inspect peak deadline pressure, shed/late/stale estimates, USB loss and linked memory costs.
automated_host_requirements: Existing backup/library/USB regressions pass and audio output stays unchanged.
The actual device linker regions fit; no runtime memory total is inferred from host process sizes.
threshold_policy: Calibrate on the FM-1 before defining numeric hardware gates. Track changes before assuming improvement.
